pairs.why: Both share the same clean, smooth toy finish, but A's larger, crisper build with clear vent slits reads more like a real object, as the detailed real vending machine does.
These are nearly identical, but B has crisper construction details such as the vent slits and a bolder ear disc, which match the moderate detail on the real cards.
B's cheek panel and tabbed neck ring make it look more like an assembled object, as the preferred saddles did, and its finish stays as smooth as the real cards.
A has the tabbed collar and cheek panel, which give it believable built-up parts, with the same smooth, mildly glossy finish as the real cards.
B is slightly smaller and sparser, with a flatter visor, while A's vents and firmer shapes match the real cards' level of detail better.
A has no vents and slightly simpler forms, while B's added vent detail and crisp shapes read more like the built real props.
